title: Output register under appending a symbol
statement: For every finite Boolean word $w$ and optional Boolean symbol $o$, the output register of the word formed by appending $o$ to $w$ equals the result of pushing $o$ onto the output register of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $o$ is either absent or a Boolean symbol
